options.name: name
options.description: Name of the package to install, upgrade, or remove.

options.name: prompts
options.description: List of regular expressions that can be used to detect prompts during pear package installation to answer the expected question. Prompts are processed in the same order as the packages list. You can optionally specify an answer to any question in the list. If no answer is provided, the list item must contain only the regular expression.
